A Little Note from the Author

Milo was my tiny Maltese, and for more than a decade, he filled our days with so much love and laughter. From his daily walkies to his favourite toys, he had a way of making even the simplest moments feel special.

Fiadh is his little cousin. They only met a few times when she was a baby, but as she grew, she heard lots of stories about him. I began to imagine all the little adventures they might have shared if they'd had more time together.

And that's how Milo & Fiadh began.

These books are my way of keeping Milo's memory alive while sharing a little of the happiness he brought into our lives. I hope their stories bring smiles, giggles, and lots of cozy reading moments to your family, too.
